From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Donald Trump, the 45th and 47th [president of the United States](/wiki/President_of_the_United_States). [Donald Trump](/wiki/Donald_Trump) made 19 international trips to 25 countries (in addition to visiting the [West Bank](/wiki/West_Bank)) during [his first presidency](/wiki/First_presidency_of_Donald_Trump), which began on [January 20, 2017](/wiki/First_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump), and ended on [January 20, 2021](/wiki/Inauguration_of_Joe_Biden). As of March 2026, Trump has made 9 international trips to 14 countries during [his second presidency](/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump), which began on [January 20, 2025](/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump).

Due to the [COVID-19 pandemic](/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic), he did not make any international trips between February 2020 and the end of his first presidency.
